title: Technology Sector Update for 08/27/2018: AMD,VMW
text:

Technology stocks were sharply higher in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding almost 0.9% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising over 1.9%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) has jumped out to a more than 11% advance on Monday after the chipmaker said it has introduced the Radeon Pro V340 graphics card, a high-performance dual-GPU virtual desktop infrastructure device. The AMD Radeon Pro V340 graphics card is expected to be available during Q4.
In other sector news:
- VMware ( VMW ) has turned lower Monday afternoon, sinking almost 1% and giving back an equally sized gain for the networking equipment company after Sunday launching its VMware Cloud on AWS on Amazon's web services for the Asia-Pacific region. The integrated cloud offering was jointly developed by AWS and VMware used to migrate and extend their on-premises from VMware vSphere-based environments to the AWS Cloud.
